structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import ChatMessage
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import (
    TextPart,
    normalize_chat_message,
    normalize_content,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTIMODAL_CONTENT_NORMALIZATION[revision==2]")
def test_normalized_parts_are_tuples_in_caller_order() -> None:
    source = ChatMessage(
        role="user",
        parts=("first", "second", "third"),
        meta={"attempt": 1},
    )

    normalized = normalize_chat_message(source)

    assert isinstance(normalized.parts, tuple)
    assert normalized.parts == (
        TextPart(kind="text", text="first"),
        TextPart(kind="text", text="second"),
        TextPart(kind="text", text="third"),
    )

    empty = normalize_chat_message(ChatMessage(role="user", parts=()))
    assert isinstance(empty.parts, tuple)
    assert empty.parts == ()

    single = normalize_content("hello")
    assert isinstance(single.parts, tuple)
    assert single.parts == (TextPart(kind="text", text="hello"),)
